name: Houou no Miko
source:
A young man designated as the phoenix deity. Ryujin's enemy. Though he may be rude at times, his cool demeanor and excellent physicality are his defining traits. His weapon of choice is a blazing axe.

[Translated from [url=https://www.gamecity.ne.jp/haruka-ryugu/characters/subchara.html#subchara3]official website[/url]]
